subject.title: improve: reduce GPT-5.6 coding harness overhead

question: Should this security- and compatibility-sensitive Codex/QA change wait for a complete current-main and sibling-Codex contract review plus final published-head live proof before any merge decision?
rationale: Repository policy requires direct inspection of sibling `../codex` for Codex-related verdicts, and this review environment could not execute even read-only source commands.

options.title: Complete the evidence review
options.body: Re-run review with read access to current main and sibling Codex, then inspect the final published-head live artifact before deciding whether to merge.

options.title: Review manually now
options.body: A maintainer with local repository access can inspect the merge result, Codex contract, and redacted runtime evidence directly.

recommendation.title: Complete the evidence review
